metas.name: Mean Girls
metas.description: If you loved Clueless and 10 Things I Hate About You, this iconic, highly quotable teen comedy is the ultimate match for your taste in smart, lighthearted high school humor.

metas.name: Legally Blonde
metas.description: Shares the fashionable, deceptively smart, and uplifting protagonist energy of Clueless, making it a perfect cozy feel-good watch.

metas.name: Easy A
metas.description: Much like 10 Things I Hate About You, this is a witty, modern high school adaptation of classic literature filled with charm and clever comedy.

metas.name: Stardust
metas.description: A perfect transition from Dungeons & Dragons and Fantastic Beasts, offering a cozy, highly entertaining fantasy adventure filled with humor and romance.

metas.name: The Princess Bride
metas.description: An absolute classic that matches the meta-humor, romance, and lighthearted fantasy adventure vibes of Dungeons & Dragons: Honor Among Thieves.

metas.name: Knives Out
metas.description: Since you have the upcoming Wake Up Dead Man on your watchlist, you will love the star-studded, hilarious, and brilliant whodunit that started the franchise.

metas.name: Glass Onion: A Knives Out Mystery
metas.description: The direct predecessor to Wake Up Dead Man, offering another colorful, hilarious, and wildly entertaining puzzlebox mystery.

metas.name: Logan Lucky
metas.description: A lighthearted, witty heist-comedy that perfectly captures the breezy, crime-centric charm of Get Shorty and The Nice Guys.

metas.name: Kiss Kiss Bang Bang
metas.description: Written and directed by Shane Black (who also made The Nice Guys), this hilarious neo-noir buddy comedy shares the exact same sharp, rapid-fire dialogue.

metas.name: Enchanted
metas.description: Blends magical fantasy with lighthearted rom-com tropes, hitting the same sweet, comforting notes as Practical Magic.

metas.name: Whisper of the Heart
metas.description: If you loved the gentle, nostalgic, and romantic slice-of-life nature of Studio Ghibli's Only Yesterday, this film is its perfect companion piece.

metas.name: The Boy and the Beast
metas.description: Captures the vibrant, imaginative fantasy elements of Night Is Short, Walk On Girl, mixed with an heartwarming adventure narrative.

metas.name: Free Guy
metas.description: An incredibly fun, high-energy action-adventure movie that plays with video game tropes, sharing a spiritual connection to the modern Jumanji films.

metas.name: Guardians of the Galaxy
metas.description: Matches the colorful, music-driven, and highly comedic sci-fi action aesthetic of Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: The Mummy
metas.description: The ultimate comfort action-adventure movie. It shares the same campy, thrilling, and comedic dungeon-crawling energy as Dungeons & Dragons.

metas.name: Shaun of the Dead
metas.description: A brilliant genre-blending comedy that matches the sharp-witted pacing of The Nice Guys and the absurdist fun of Ace Ventura.

metas.name: Hot Fuzz
metas.description: Arguably the greatest buddy-cop action comedy ever made, delivering the same hilarious character chemistry found in The Nice Guys.

metas.name: Love & Monsters
metas.description: An incredibly charming, lighthearted post-apocalyptic adventure that matches the creature-filled fun of Jumanji and Fantastic Beasts.

metas.name: Crazy Rich Asians
metas.description: A lush, colorful, and hilariously heartwarming modern rom-com that fits right in with Clueless and 10 Things I Hate About You.

metas.name: She's the Man
metas.description: Another hilarious, comfortable 2000s teen comedy adapted from Shakespeare, carrying the exact same DNA as 10 Things I Hate About You.

metas.name: About Time
metas.description: A beautifully heartwarming rom-com with a sci-fi/fantasy twist that perfectly balances comfort, romance, and life-affirming themes.

metas.name: Lemony Snicket's A Series of Unfortunate Events
metas.description: Offers a whimsical, visually stunning gothic fantasy vibe that fans of Practical Magic and Fantastic Beasts will adore.

metas.name: Sherlock Holmes
metas.description: Features a brilliant, highly entertaining buddy-cop dynamic and mystery element that matches The Nice Guys and Get Shorty.

metas.name: Tropic Thunder
metas.description: If you enjoy the fearless, laugh-out-loud comedy of Brüno, this meta-satirical action comedy is a must-watch.

metas.name: Bullet Train
metas.description: An incredibly fast-paced, neon-drenched, and hilariously violent action film that matches the energetic, comedic tone of Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: The Mask
metas.description: For fans of Ace Ventura: Pet Detective, this features Jim Carrey at the peak of his physical comedy powers in a fun superhero fantasy setting.

metas.name: Austin Powers: International Man of Mystery
metas.description: Offers the same silly, satirical, and highly eccentric character-driven comedy found in Ace Ventura and Brüno.

metas.name: A Fish Called Wanda
metas.description: A masterpiece of crime comedy filled with eccentric characters, fitting perfectly alongside Get Shorty and The Nice Guys.

metas.name: Yesterday
metas.description: A sweet, lighthearted high-concept rom-com about a musician who realizes he is the only person on Earth who remembers The Beatles.

metas.name: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
metas.description: An absolute visual masterpiece that mixes incredible comic-book action with the same joyful, comedic heart as Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: The Grand Budapest Hotel
metas.description: A highly stylized, eccentric, and hilarious caper that matches the witty tone of Knives Out and the whimsical charm of fantasy adventures.

metas.name: Midnight in Paris
metas.description: A charming, magical-realism rom-com that captures the whimsical, romantic fantasy elements of Night Is Short, Walk On Girl.

metas.name: Zombieland
metas.description: A hilarious, fast-paced road-trip comedy that turns a monster-infested world into a delightful, cozy playground.

metas.name: National Treasure
metas.description: A peak comfort movie featuring history-themed puzzles, high-stakes fun, and the light adventure tone of the Jumanji franchise.

metas.name: How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days
metas.description: A foundational classic of the golden age of romantic comedies, carrying the same lighthearted romance and banter as Clueless.

metas.name: Spy
metas.description: An incredibly funny, action-packed espionage comedy that offers endless laughs and highly satisfying action sequences.

metas.name: The Secret Life of Walter Mitty
metas.description: A visually breathtaking, deeply comforting, and feel-good adventure film about breaking out of your shell.

metas.name: Amélie
metas.description: If you loved the quirky, stylized, and romantic visual journey of Night Is Short, Walk On Girl, this cozy masterpiece is an absolute essential.

metas.name: Shazam!
metas.description: A superhero movie with the heart of Big, delivering the exact same family-friendly, high-concept fun as Jumanji.

metas.name: What We Do in the Shadows
metas.description: Directed by Taika Waititi (Thor: Ragnarok), this hilarious mockumentary about vampire roommates is incredibly witty, lighthearted, and unique.
